summary: Two-month summer research internship across NISER's schools; the 2027 call is expected in February–April.
eligibility: Indian UG/PG students; school-wise eligibility, with a bonafide/NOC letter and two referee letters.
title: NISER Summer Internship Programme (NSIP) 2027

prize.description: Stipend as stated in the annual NSIP notice.

notes: Based on the 2026 cycle (form opened 25 Feb, deadline 10 April 2026); the 2027 notice is not out yet.
NISER's School of Biological Sciences ran a separate winter internship with a 14 Nov deadline in 2025; no 2026 notice was found.
